samples.source: 绿色版与安装版共用同一份配置解析规则，避免行为分叉。
samples.reference: Keep one config resolution rule across portable and installed forms, or behaviour forks.
samples.hypothesis: The green version shares the same configuration resolution rule with the installed version, avoiding behavioral crossbows.

samples.source: 运行时依赖版本要锁定，浮动的次版本会改变推理结果。
samples.reference: Pin runtime dependency versions; a floating minor version can change inference output.
samples.hypothesis: Run-time depends on the version to lock, and the floating sub-version changes the reasoning.

samples.source: 构建机与开发机不一致时，以可复现的干净环境为准。
samples.reference: When build and dev machines differ, the clean reproducible one is authoritative.
samples.hypothesis: If the builder is inconsistent with the developer, reference is made to the clean environment in which it can be repeated.

samples.source: 交付清单要写清哪些模型需另行获取，避免装机后才发现缺件。
samples.reference: State which models must be fetched separately, so a gap is not found after installation.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery list needs to be clear as to which models are to be obtained separately, so that the installation is avoided before missing items are detected.

samples.source: 打包体积增长要能归因到具体新增项，别只报总大小。
samples.reference: Attribute growth in package size to a specific addition, rather than reporting a total.
samples.hypothesis: Pack volume growth should be attributable to specific additions and not only to the total size.

samples.source: 安装后自检要覆盖动态库加载与模型可读两项。
samples.reference: A post-install self-check must cover loading the native library and reading a model.
samples.hypothesis: Self-checking after installation covers both the dynamic library load and the model readable.

samples.source: 现场无外网时，更新机制要支持离线补丁包。
samples.reference: With no outbound access, the update path must accept an offline patch package.
samples.hypothesis: When off-site coverage is not available, the update mechanism supports off-line patches.

samples.source: 配置热更新未实现前，改配置要能在文档里指明需重启哪一层。
samples.reference: Until hot reload exists, document which layer a config change restarts.
samples.hypothesis: Configure the thermal update before it is realized. The configuration is to indicate in the document which layer should be restarted.

samples.source: 崩溃报告默认不收集正文，只收集调用位置与版本。
samples.reference: Crash reports collect location and version by default, never the text.
samples.hypothesis: The crash report by default does not collect the body, only the call location and version.

samples.source: 打包时排除缓存目录，避免把开发机的记忆库一起发出去。
samples.reference: Exclude cache directories when packaging, so a developer's memory store is never shipped.
samples.hypothesis: Pack to remove cache directories and avoid sending the developer's memory library together.

samples.source: 双平台各配一个薄壳入口，逻辑只放在脚本主体里。
samples.reference: Keep one thin launcher per OS and put the logic in the shared script.
samples.hypothesis: The two platforms are each equipped with a thin shell entrance, and logic is confined to the script subject.

samples.source: 构建脚本要能只跳过已完成且哈希未变的阶段。
samples.reference: The build script must skip a stage whose inputs are unchanged by digest.
samples.hypothesis: Build a script that only skips the stage that has been completed and Hash hasn't changed.

samples.source: 干净构建要能一条命令复现，避免依赖历史产物。
samples.reference: A clean build must be reproducible with one command, without relying on prior artefacts.
samples.hypothesis: Clean construction needs to be able to reproduce an order and avoid relying on historical products.

samples.source: 版本信息要在界面与诊断接口一致显示。
samples.reference: Show the same version string in the UI and in diagnostics.
samples.hypothesis: The version is displayed on the interface in accordance with the diagnostic interface.

samples.source: 交付物要包含许可矩阵，覆盖随包分发的一切第三方成分。
samples.reference: Ship a licence matrix covering every third-party component in the package.
samples.hypothesis: Delivery shall contain a permit matrix covering all third-party components distributed with the package.

samples.source: 模型文件过大时按语言对拆分下载，避免首装全量拉取。
samples.reference: Split model downloads per language pair so a first install fetches nothing wholesale.
samples.hypothesis: When the model file is too large, downloads the split by language to avoid the full volume of the initials.

samples.source: 装机脚本要幂等，重复执行不产生第二份配置。
samples.reference: Keep install scripting idempotent; running it twice must not create a second config.
samples.hypothesis: Sets a script, etc., and repeated execution does not produce a second configuration.

samples.source: 安装失败要留下可读的原因文件，而不是只有弹窗。
samples.reference: On failure leave a readable reason file, not just a dialog.
samples.hypothesis: The installation failed to leave a readable cause document, not just a bullet window.

samples.source: 现场排障优先加诊断输出，而不是先改代码复现。
samples.reference: Prefer extra diagnostics when debugging in the field, rather than editing code to reproduce it.
samples.hypothesis: On-site detoxification gives priority to diagnostic output rather than re-coding.

samples.source: 打包链路的每一步产物都要有校验和，避免半传文件进入安装。
samples.reference: Checksum every stage of the packaging chain so a truncated file never reaches an installer.
samples.hypothesis: Each step of the packing chain requires a check-and-check to avoid the semi-transmitting of documents into the installation.

samples.source: 交付版本与仓库提交要能一一对应，便于事后追溯。
samples.reference: Map each delivered version to a repository commit for later tracing.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery version corresponds to the warehouse submission and is easily retroactive.

samples.source: 默认数据目录的解析规则要在各语言绑定之间保持一致。
samples.reference: Keep the default data-directory rule identical across bindings.
samples.hypothesis: The default data directory resolution rules need to be consistent between language bindings.

samples.source: 跨机器复现问题需要同时给出版本、配置与模型清单。
samples.reference: Reproducing an issue across machines needs version, config and a model inventory.
samples.hypothesis: The cross-machine recurrence problem requires a list of versions, configurations and models.

samples.source: 安装介质要校验自身完整性再开始复制文件。
samples.reference: Verify installer integrity before copying any file.
samples.hypothesis: Install the medium to verify your integrity and then start copying the file.

samples.source: 交付时把复现命令一起写进说明，客户才能自己重跑。
samples.reference: Include the reproduction command so a customer can rerun measurements alone.
samples.hypothesis: When delivered, repeat orders are included in the instructions so that the client can run again on its own.

samples.source: 打包要区分开发构建与发布构建的产物路径。
samples.reference: Separate development and release output paths in packaging.
samples.hypothesis: Pack to distinguish the path between the development construction and the release of the construction.

samples.source: 无网络环境下要能只装文档与工具而不装模型。
samples.reference: Allow installing docs and tools without models where there is no network.
samples.hypothesis: In a network-free environment, you can load only documents and tools instead of models.

samples.source: 包内脚本文本模式写入会带平台换行，按字节写更稳。
samples.reference: Write packaged scripts byte-wise; text mode sneaks platform line endings in.
samples.hypothesis: Script text mode writing in the package will lead to a change of platform and a smoother byte.

samples.source: 发布构建要能在流水线里复现同一哈希，否则版本不可信。
samples.reference: A release build must be reproducible to the same hash in CI, or a version number means little.
samples.hypothesis: The release of the construction requires that the same Hashi be repeated in the current line, otherwise the version is not credible.

samples.source: 装机后的首次启动体验要有明确路径，避免用户停在空白界面。
samples.reference: The first launch after install needs a guided path, not an empty window.
samples.hypothesis: The first start-up experience after installation needs to have clear paths to avoid users stopping at a blank interface.

samples.source: 安装包的版本号要与运行时自检报出的版本一致。
samples.reference: Keep the installer's version equal to what the runtime self-check reports.
samples.hypothesis: The version number of the installation package is to be consistent with the version self-inspected at the time of running.

samples.source: 依赖锁定文件要随包发布，便于现场复核。
samples.reference: Ship the lockfile with the package so a site can re-check dependencies.
samples.hypothesis: Reliance on locked documents is issued with packages to facilitate on-site review.

samples.source: 构建产物目录要与源码目录分离，避免误提交二进制。
samples.reference: Keep build output separate from sources so binaries never get committed.
samples.hypothesis: Build the product catalogue to separate it from the source directory and avoid submitting the binary by mistake.

samples.source: 现场升级前先备份数据目录，失败时能整目录还原。
samples.reference: Back up the data directory before a field upgrade so a failure restores wholesale.
samples.hypothesis: Backup data directories before on-site upgrades can be restored if they fail.

samples.source: 打包时剔除测试夹具与开发脚本，减少体积与误用面。
samples.reference: Strip test fixtures and dev scripts from packaging, cutting size and misuse.
samples.hypothesis: The package removes test kits and develops scripts to reduce volume and misuse.

samples.source: 交付文档里的命令要与实际入口一致，避免过期写法。
samples.reference: Keep commands in delivered docs matching real entry points, or they rot.
samples.hypothesis: The order in the delivery document is to be consistent with the actual entry and to avoid obsolescence.

samples.source: 构建脚本失败要非零退出并指明失败阶段。
samples.reference: A failing build step must exit non-zero and name the stage.
samples.hypothesis: Builds a script that fails to exit without zero and specifies the stage of failure.

samples.source: 发布说明要写清哪些行为变化会影响既有指标的对比。
samples.reference: Release notes must state which behaviour changes break comparison with prior metrics.
samples.hypothesis: A note was issued to clarify which behavioural changes would affect the comparison of existing indicators.

samples.source: 安装介质体积上限由首装网络条件决定，而不是由功能数量决定。
samples.reference: Package size is bounded by first-install network conditions, not by feature count.
samples.hypothesis: The maximum size of the installation medium is determined by the condition of the primary network, not by the number of functions.

samples.source: 现场环境差异要靠诊断接口回读，而不是靠聊天记录推断。
samples.reference: Read field differences back through diagnostics instead of inferring them from chat.
samples.hypothesis: On-site environmental differences are read back through diagnostic interfaces, rather than extrapolation from chat records.

samples.source: 交付物要能在目标机上离线验证哈希一致。
samples.reference: Artefacts must be verifiable offline on the target machine.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery should be capable of offline verification on the target plane.

samples.source: 打包链路要能只重建受影响的部分，缩短反馈。
samples.reference: Rebuild only what a change affects, to keep packaging feedback short.
samples.hypothesis: Packing links requires that only the affected parts be rebuilt and feedback reduced.

samples.source: 版本兼容承诺要写明弃用窗口长度，便于客户排期。
samples.reference: State the deprecation window in compatibility promises so customers can plan.
samples.hypothesis: The release compatibility commitment is to specify the length of the disposal window to facilitate the scheduling of the client.

samples.source: 发布构建的产物清单要包含每个文件的来源与许可。
samples.reference: A release manifest lists each file's provenance and licence.
samples.hypothesis: The list of products to be built is to include the source and permission of each document.

samples.source: 装机脚本要检测缺依赖并给出具体的获取命令。
samples.reference: Detect missing dependencies at install and print the exact fetch command.
samples.hypothesis: The installed script detects lack of dependency and gives a specific command to access.

samples.source: 现场没有包管理器时，依赖要能整体随包交付。
samples.reference: Ship dependencies whole where a site has no package manager.
samples.hypothesis: In the absence of a package manager at the site, reliance is placed on delivering the package as a whole.

samples.source: 构建与发布分离，避免开发机凭据进入产物。
samples.reference: Separate building from publishing so developer credentials never enter artefacts.
samples.hypothesis: Build and publish separations to avoid developing machine entry into products.

samples.source: 可复现构建要固定环境变量与路径归一化规则。
samples.reference: Fix environment variables and path normalization for reproducible builds.
samples.hypothesis: Reverts the rule that you want to regularize the environment variable and path.

samples.source: 交付验收要包含一次干净机器安装，避免只在开发机可用。
samples.reference: Include one clean-machine install in acceptance, or it only works on a dev box.
samples.hypothesis: Delivery of acceptance and inspection is to include a clean machine installation to avoid being available only to developers.

samples.source: 包内不要残留绝对路径默认值，否则他人环境不可复现。
samples.reference: Leave no absolute default paths inside a package, or another machine cannot reproduce.
samples.hypothesis: No absolute path default should be left in the package, otherwise the environment cannot be repeated.

samples.source: 发布前跑一次全量门禁并把末行结果记进台账。
samples.reference: Run the full gate before release and record its last line in the ledger.
samples.hypothesis: Run full house closures and record the end-line results in front of the release.

samples.source: 交付介质要能长期保存，校验和与包同存放。
samples.reference: Store the checksum beside the media so an archive stays verifiable years later.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery medium should be kept for a long period of time, verified and stored with the package.

samples.source: 升级路径要覆盖从最旧交付版本到最新一跳的验证。
samples.reference: Test the upgrade path from the oldest delivered version in one hop.
samples.hypothesis: The upgrade path should cover the verification from the oldest delivery version to the latest jump.

samples.source: 现场回滚演练要在交付前做一次，别把第一次留给客户。
samples.reference: Practise the rollback before delivery; the first attempt should not be a customer's.
samples.hypothesis: The rollback exercise is done once before delivery and does not leave the first time to the client.

samples.source: 打包时把第三方素材的许可文本一并装入目录。
samples.reference: Bundle third-party licence texts alongside the packaged material.
samples.hypothesis: When packed, the authorized text of the third-party material is added to the directory.

samples.source: 构建环境要固定工具链小版本，避免优化级差异影响性能数字。
samples.reference: Pin toolchain minor versions so optimisation differences do not move performance numbers.
samples.hypothesis: The construction of the environment requires a small version of the tool chain to be fixed and to avoid optimizing differentials affecting performance figures.

samples.source: 交付包要能单独校验某一个文件的完整性，便于定位损坏。
samples.reference: Allow verifying one file at a time, to localise corruption.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery package should be capable of independently verifying the integrity of a particular document and facilitating damage to positioning.

samples.source: 安装后的自检输出要能复制给支持人员，含版本与路径摘要。
samples.reference: Make post-install self-check output copyable to support, with versions and path digests.
samples.hypothesis: The self-check output after installation is copied to the support person, with a summary of the version and path.

samples.source: 无网环境下的文档要随包离线可读。
samples.reference: Ship documentation readable offline for disconnected environments.
samples.hypothesis: Documents in a netless environment are to be read offline with the package.

samples.source: 包内示例语料要确认可公开，避免带入客户素材。
samples.reference: Confirm sample corpora are public-safe, never client material.
samples.hypothesis: The illustrative language in the package is to be confirmed as publicly available and avoid bringing in customer material.

samples.source: 发布构建日志要归档，便于事后核对当时环境与结果。
samples.reference: Archive release build logs to reconstruct the environment and outcome later.
samples.hypothesis: The publication of the build log is to be archived to facilitate an ex post facto reconciliation of the environment and results at the time.

samples.source: 交付版本要能回答某个功能在哪个版本引入。
samples.reference: A delivered version must answer which release introduced a feature.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery version needs to be able to answer in which version a function is introduced.

samples.source: 构建脚本的缓存目录要能指定到盘外，避免污染工作区。
samples.reference: Allow pointing the build cache outside the tree, to keep the working copy clean.
samples.hypothesis: Builds a cache directory of scripts that can be assigned outside the disk to avoid contamination of the workspace.

samples.source: 打包前的静态检查要拦住明显的界面与文案错误。
samples.reference: Run static checks before packaging to catch obvious UI and text faults.
samples.hypothesis: The static check before the pack stops the obvious interfaces and file errors.

samples.source: 装机脚本要在结束时打印已安装组件与版本一览。
samples.reference: Print the installed components and versions at the end of setup.
samples.hypothesis: The installed components and the version are printed at the end of the loading script.

samples.source: 现场依赖缺失时，安装器要能指出缺的那一个而不是整体失败。
samples.reference: Report the single missing dependency, rather than failing the whole install.
samples.hypothesis: When on-site reliance is missing, the installation should be able to point to the missing one rather than to fail as a whole.

samples.source: 交付物的可复现性以他人能跑通为准，而不是本机能跑通。
samples.reference: Reproducibility means someone else can run it, not that this machine can.
samples.hypothesis: The recoverability of the delivery is based on the ability of others to run, rather than on the ability to run.

samples.source: 同一张显卡上并行跑推理与合成会互相争用，评测要分阶段进行。
samples.reference: Sharing one GPU between inference and synthesis starves both; measure them in separate phases.
samples.hypothesis: Parallel running reasoning and synthesis on the same graphic card will compete with each other and will be evaluated in stages.

samples.source: 显存占用达到临界时系统会开始用内存换页，延迟随之出现长尾。
samples.reference: Near the memory ceiling the system starts paging, and latency grows a long tail.
samples.hypothesis: The system begins to change pages with memory when the criticality of the storage is reached, with the delay resulting in long tails.

samples.source: 热降频会让同一模型在连续负载后段变慢，短测看不出这一影响。
samples.reference: Thermal throttling slows the same model late in a sustained load, which a short test will miss.
samples.hypothesis: Thermal precipitation slows the same model at the end of a continuous load, and short measurements do not reveal this effect.

samples.source: 笔记本在电池供电时的功耗墙会改变吞吐，性能数字要注明供电状态。
samples.reference: Battery power caps throughput on laptops, so note the power state next to any number.
samples.hypothesis: The working walls of the laptop when the battery is powered change the ingestion, and the performance figures indicate the state of the power supply.

samples.source: 批处理的吞吐提升要除以显存代价来看，否则只是用资源换时间。
samples.reference: Judge batch throughput against the memory it costs, or it is only buying time with resources.
samples.hypothesis: Batch-processing throughput upgrades are considered to be less significant than savings, otherwise resources are used for time-saving purposes.

samples.source: 磁盘读入模型的时间应计入首装等待，而不是被当成推理耗时。
samples.reference: Loading a model from disk belongs to first-start wait, not to inference time.
samples.hypothesis: The time taken for the disk to read the model should be taken into account in the initials and not used as time for reasoning.

samples.source: 同一份权重在不同优化级别下的输出可能不同，回归要固定构建。
samples.reference: The same weights can behave differently across optimisation levels, so pin the build for regressions.
samples.hypothesis: The output of the same weight may differ from the output at different optimized levels, and the regression is fixed.

samples.source: 采样噪声与真实性能变化靠重复测量区分，单次运行不足以判断。
samples.reference: Repeat a measurement to tell sampling noise from a real change; one run cannot decide.
samples.hypothesis: Sample noise changes are distinguished by repeated measurements, and single operations are not sufficient to judge changes in real performance.

samples.source: 缓存命中率变化会同时影响延迟与成本，两者要一起看。
samples.reference: A shift in hit rate moves latency and cost together, so read them as a pair.
samples.hypothesis: Changes in the CLC can affect both delays and costs, both of which need to be seen together.

samples.source: 慢盘上的并发读写会让队列等待被误读成模型变慢。
samples.reference: On a slow disk, queueing under concurrent IO reads as a slower model.
samples.hypothesis: The simultaneous reading and writing on the slow drive slows the queue until it is misreaded into a model.

samples.source: 性能回归要给出分布而不是均值，长尾正是用户体感所在。
samples.reference: Report a distribution for a regression, not a mean; the tail is where the experience lives.
samples.hypothesis: Performance returns give distribution rather than parity, and long tails are what the user senses.

samples.source: 量化后的精度损失要用任务指标衡量，而不是只看权重误差。
samples.reference: Judge quantisation loss on task metrics, not on weight error alone.
samples.hypothesis: Quantified precision losses are measured by mission indicators rather than by weight errors.

samples.source: 多核扩展在队列同步点上会停下来，加速曲线不是线性的。
samples.reference: Multi-core scaling stalls at queue synchronisation points, so the speedup curve is not linear.
samples.hypothesis: Multinuclear expansion stops at the queue synchronous points, and acceleration curves are not linear.

samples.source: 首次请求包含惰性初始化，冷启动时间要单独列出。
samples.reference: The first request carries lazy initialisation, so report cold start separately.
samples.hypothesis: The first request includes inert initialization, with a separate list of cold start times.

samples.source: 长时间运行后的内存增长要区分缓存驻留与真实泄露。
samples.reference: Distinguish cache residency from a real leak when memory grows over time.
samples.hypothesis: The memory growth after long run differentiates between cache presence and real leakage.

samples.source: 换页与内存回收会在采样窗口里制造毛刺，需要复采确认。
samples.reference: Paging and garbage collection create spikes, so confirm with a repeat sample.
samples.hypothesis: The change of page and memory recovery will create a sting in the sample window, which will require confirmation of retroactivity.

samples.source: 同一批任务在不同顺序下耗时不同，基准要固定输入顺序。
samples.reference: The same workload takes different times in different orders, so fix input order in a benchmark.
samples.hypothesis: The same task is time-consuming under different orders, and the baseline is to be entered in a fixed order.

samples.source: 性能承诺要绑定运行环境说明，包括芯片、供电与并发规模。
samples.reference: Attach the environment to any performance promise: chip, power state and concurrency.
samples.hypothesis: Performance commitment binds the operating environment statement, including chips, power supply and co-generation.

samples.source: 推理与预处理重叠时，单段耗时会小于两段之和，别误判成加速。
samples.reference: Overlapping inference with pre-processing makes a segment look shorter than the sum, not faster.
samples.hypothesis: When reasoning overlaps with pre-treatment, a single paragraph is less time-consuming than the sum of the two paragraphs, and is not miscalculated to accelerate.

samples.source: 一个更小的模型在延迟敏感场景可能胜过更大的模型，质量差要看任务。
samples.reference: A smaller model can beat a larger one where latency matters; check the quality cost per task.
samples.hypothesis: A smaller model may be better than a larger model in delaying sensitive scenes, with poor quality depending on the mission.

samples.source: 缓存预取要按语料重复度决定，随机输入下预取只是额外开销。
samples.reference: Size cache prefetch to corpus repetition; on random input prefetch is pure overhead.
samples.hypothesis: The cache prefetch is determined by the degree of repetition of the text, and the random input of the prefetch is an additional expense.

samples.source: 并发解码不上调吞吐时，说明瓶颈在算力而不是调度。
samples.reference: If concurrent decoding does not raise throughput, the bottleneck is compute rather than scheduling.
samples.hypothesis: When the code is not decoded, it indicates that the bottlenecks are calculating rather than scheduling.

samples.source: 负载上升时先退化的是尾延迟而不是中位数，指标要成对看。
samples.reference: Under rising load the tail degrades before the median, so read the pair together.
samples.hypothesis: The load rise is preceded by a tail delay rather than a median, and the indicator is to be viewed in perspective.

samples.source: 把等待时间与处理时间混在一个指标里会掩盖排队积压。

samples.hypothesis: The source note is uniform in English and user-oriented scripts by product language.

samples.source: 每个对外数字都要能追到一次可复现运行。
samples.reference: Trace every published number to one reproducible run.
samples.hypothesis: Every external number must be able to track back and run again.

samples.source: 评审前要自查规范合规缺口，不等他人指出。
samples.reference: Self-check convention compliance before review, not after being told.
samples.hypothesis: The review is preceded by a self-checking of compliance gaps, which does not wait for others to point out.

samples.source: 变更后的旧承诺句要一并搜干净，避免残留两处。
samples.reference: Search out stale promises after a change, so no second copy survives.
samples.hypothesis: The changed old commitment words should be searched together to avoid the two remaining.

samples.source: 台账与代码不一致时先信代码并回写台账。
samples.reference: Trust code over the ledger on conflict, then correct the ledger.
samples.hypothesis: If the account is inconsistent with the code, write the code and return the account.

samples.source: 一次跑批前要确认范围参数与它可能覆盖什么。
samples.reference: Confirm a run's scope and what it can overwrite before starting it.
samples.hypothesis: Before a run, confirm the parameters of the range and what it might cover.

samples.source: 文档里的命令要能直接执行，不写伪代码。
samples.reference: Keep documented commands executable, never pseudocode.
samples.hypothesis: The command in the document is executed directly and does not write a false code.

samples.source: 测试的跳过原因要打印出来，SKIP 不是通过。
samples.reference: Print a skip reason; a skip is not a pass.
samples.hypothesis: The test's skipping reason to print it out, SKIP isn't passed.

samples.source: 一次修复的解释要绑定到具体证据而不是印象。
samples.reference: Bind an explanation to concrete evidence, not to recollection.
samples.hypothesis: The explanation for one restoration is tied to specific evidence rather than to impressions.

samples.source: 共享计数只允许一处真相，两处会互相打脸。
samples.reference: Keep one source of truth for a shared counter, or two disagree.
samples.hypothesis: The sharing of counts allows only one truth and both will hit each other in the face.

samples.source: 新旋钮要有上下界与注入接缝，便于测试钉住。
samples.reference: Give a new knob bounds and an injection seam so tests can pin it.
samples.hypothesis: The new switch button should have upper and lower bounds and injection stitches, so that the test can be nailed.

samples.source: 一次变更的边界要在提交信息里写清未做什么。
samples.reference: State what a change deliberately did not do, in its message.
samples.hypothesis: The boundaries of a change need to be clear in the submission of information on what is not being done.

samples.source: 缺陷编号要与分项口径一致，避免按编号排工错位.
samples.reference: Keep a defect's sub-item numbering consistent, or work split by number misaligns.
samples.hypothesis: Deficiencies need to match the sub-caliber to avoid misnumbering.

samples.source: 可复跑的入口要登记在意图清单里，别只留在聊天记录。
samples.reference: Register a re-runnable entry in the intent table, not in chat history.
samples.hypothesis: Rerunable entry points are to be registered in the Intent List, and not just in chat records.

samples.source: 一次评测的输入与脚本一起入库，便于重放。
samples.reference: Commit an evaluation's inputs with its script, to allow replay.
samples.hypothesis: The input for one evaluation is entered into the library with scripts to facilitate replaying.

samples.source: 测量结果要注明环境前提，跨机引用时不可省略。
samples.reference: Note environment preconditions; they are not optional in a cross-machine citation.
samples.hypothesis: The results of the measurements should indicate the environmental premises and cannot be omitted from cross-references.

samples.source: 文档的引用要指向能被他人跑起来的东西。
samples.reference: Cite things other people can actually run.
samples.hypothesis: Document references point to something that can be run by someone else.

samples.source: 一次修复要连带检查同一形状的其他位置。
samples.reference: After a fix, check for the same shape elsewhere in the tree.
samples.hypothesis: A restoration is to be accompanied by an examination of the other positions in the same shape.

samples.source: 语音闭环的耗时由分段、识别、翻译与合成四段串联而成。
samples.reference: The voice loop chains segmentation, recognition, translation and synthesis in series.
samples.hypothesis: The length of the speech closed rings is made up of a series of segments, identification, translation and synthesis.

samples.source: 识别错误会向翻译与合成传染，段级评估要独立跑。
samples.reference: Recognition errors propagate into translation and synthesis, so score segments independently.
samples.hypothesis: Error identification can spread to translators and synthetics, and sector assessments run independently.

samples.source: 麦克风增益过高会让削波后的波形失去可识别性。
samples.reference: Excessive microphone gain pushes the waveform into clipping and ruins recognisability.
samples.hypothesis: An over-enrichment of the microphone would render the ripple wave shape unrecognizable.

samples.source: 录音静音裁剪要在分段之后做，不能在波形上做能量阈值一刀切。
samples.reference: Trim silence after segmentation, not by a blanket energy threshold on the waveform.
samples.hypothesis: The sound sound clipping is to be done after the segment, and the energy threshold cannot be cut across the wave shape.

samples.source: 扬声器输出的音量归一化要放在编码前而不是编码后。
samples.reference: Normalise speaker output volume before encoding, not after.
samples.hypothesis: The volume integration of the loudspeaker output should be placed before, not after, the encoding.

samples.source: 播放头跨段跳变时要触发一次冲刷，避免残留上一段音频。
samples.reference: Flush the buffer when the playhead crosses a segment, or the previous audio lingers.
samples.hypothesis: Plays a head-over jump that triggers a brush to avoid a residual audio.

samples.source: 多说话人播客要先分流再分配合成通道。
samples.reference: Route multiple speakers apart before assigning synthesis channels.
samples.hypothesis: Multi-speaker podcasts have to divert and distribute synthetic channels.

samples.source: 语音链路的模型体积上限要按首装下载条件定。
samples.reference: Set the voice model size ceiling by first-install download conditions.
samples.hypothesis: The volume limit for the model of the voice link is based on the condition of the initial download.

samples.source: 演示阶段的转写加翻译不能被称为同传。
samples.reference: A transcript plus translation in a demo must not be called simultaneous interpretation.
samples.hypothesis: The transliteration and translation at the demonstration stage cannot be referred to as synonym.

samples.source: 合成侧的音色切换要在段边界生效，避免段内跳变。
samples.reference: Switch timbre at segment boundaries, not mid-segment.
samples.hypothesis: Synthetic side acoustic switching should take effect at a segment boundary to avoid internal jump.

samples.source: 识别与翻译用同一语言代码集合，避免两侧口径分叉。
samples.reference: Share one set of language codes between recognition and translation, or the two diverge.
samples.hypothesis: Identification and translation are combined in the same language code, avoiding cross-calibre forks on both sides.

samples.source: 语音素材的采样率要与模型要求对齐。
samples.reference: Match voice material's sample rate to what the model expects.
samples.hypothesis: The sampling rate of the voice material should be consistent with the model requirements.

samples.source: 分段策略改变会同时影响可懂度与延迟，需一起评估。
samples.reference: A segmentation change moves both intelligibility and latency, so judge them together.
samples.hypothesis: A change in the segment strategy would affect both understandability and delay and would need to be assessed together.

samples.source: 合成失败时保留文本结果，不能连带丢弃转写。
samples.reference: Keep the text result when synthesis fails, rather than losing the transcript too.
samples.hypothesis: Saves the text result when synthesis fails and cannot be discarded and transcribed.

samples.source: 端到端语音评测的样本要包含噪声与口音两种条件。
samples.reference: Voice evaluation samples must cover both noisy and accented conditions.
samples.hypothesis: The end-to-end voice assessment sample contains both noise and accent conditions.

samples.source: 声码器的选择影响自然度上限，与模型规模不完全同向。
samples.reference: A vocoder bounds naturalness, and not in lockstep with model size.
samples.hypothesis: The selection of acoustics affects the naturality limit and is not exactly the same as the size of the model.

samples.source: 识别语言检测在中英混排素材上不稳定，需要按语段回退。
samples.reference: Language detection is unstable on mixed Chinese-English material, so fall back per segment.
samples.hypothesis: Language recognition tests are unstable on Chinese-British blended material and need to be receded by text.

samples.source: 模型量化到 int8 后体积下降明显，自然度损失要按任务测。
samples.reference: Int8 quantisation shrinks size; measure the naturalness cost per task.
samples.hypothesis: The model was quantified to the int8 post volume decline, which was significant, and the loss of naturality was measured by mission.

samples.source: 链路里任何一段换模型，都要重跑端到端指标。
samples.reference: Rerun end-to-end metrics whenever any single model in the chain changes.
samples.hypothesis: Any remodeling in the chain requires a run-to-end indicator.

samples.source: 语音交付要能只给转写与字幕，不强制合成。
samples.reference: Allow delivery of transcript and subtitles without forcing synthesis.
samples.hypothesis: Speech delivery is limited to transliteration and subtitles, and is not forced to synthesize.

samples.source: 离线语音包要能单独更新识别或合成一侧。
samples.reference: Let an offline voice package update recognition or synthesis independently.
samples.hypothesis: The offline speech package should be able to independently update the identification or synthesis side.

samples.source: 说话人分离在重叠语音上会合并两人，需人工复核。
samples.reference: Speaker diarization merges two voices on overlap, so keep human review.
samples.hypothesis: The separation of speakers, which combines two persons on overlapping voices, requires manual review.

samples.source: 强制对齐的时间戳精度决定字幕可用性与配音定位。
samples.reference: Forced-alignment timestamp accuracy decides subtitle usability and dubbing placement.
samples.hypothesis: The time-stamping precision of the alignment is determined by the availability of subtitles and the positioning of voice.

samples.source: 逆文本规整把口语数字转成书面形式，影响下游解析。
samples.reference: Inverse text normalization turns spoken numbers into written form, which downstream parsing depends on.
samples.hypothesis: Inverse text-ordering converts the language numbers into written form, affecting the analysis downstream.

samples.source: 词表覆盖不足会让专名切成碎片，识别质量随之下降。
samples.reference: A thin vocabulary shreds proper nouns and drags recognition down.
samples.hypothesis: Inadequate coverage of the vocabulary may result in the name being cut to pieces, with a consequent decrease in the quality of identification.

samples.source: 半精度推理在部分硬件上不支持，需要回退路径。
samples.reference: Half-precision inference is unsupported on some hardware, so keep a fallback.
samples.hypothesis: Semi-accuracy reasoning is not supported on some hardware and needs to be retrogressed.

samples.source: 模型权重的来源与许可要一并交付，不能只给文件。
samples.reference: Deliver a model's provenance and licence with the weights, not the file alone.
samples.hypothesis: The origin of the model weights is to be delivered with the licence and cannot be given to documents alone.

samples.source: 流式合成落地前，语音产品叙述只承诺转写与翻译。
samples.reference: Until streaming synthesis lands, voice product copy promises transcript and translation only.
samples.hypothesis: The narrative of the voice products only promises to be transliterated and translated before the flow of synthetics to land.

samples.source: 语音链路的评测要避免与常驻服务争用同一设备。
samples.reference: Keep voice evaluation off the device a resident service is using.
samples.hypothesis: Voice links are assessed in such a way as to avoid competing with resident services for the same equipment.

samples.source: 识别置信度低的段要在字幕里标注而非静默替换成猜测。
samples.reference: Flag low-confidence segments in subtitles rather than guessing silently.
samples.hypothesis: The recognition of low-confidence segments should be marked in subtitles instead of silently replacing them with speculation.

samples.source: 音频格式转换要显式选择是否重采样并声明滤波器。
samples.reference: Make resampling and filter choice explicit in audio format conversion.
samples.hypothesis: The audio format conversion selects whether or not to resamp and announces the filter.

samples.source: 语音模型的更新周期与产品发布周期不同步，要能独立升级。
samples.reference: Voice model updates land off the product release cycle, so allow independent upgrade.
samples.hypothesis: The update cycle of the voice model is not synchronized with the product release cycle and is independently upgraded.

samples.source: 转写与译文要能分别导出，供不同下游使用。
samples.reference: Export transcript and translation separately for different downstream needs.
samples.hypothesis: The transliteration and translation are to be exported separately for different downstream uses.

samples.source: 合成语速与字幕停留时长要共同满足阅读约束。
samples.reference: Match synthesis pace and subtitle dwell to one reading constraint.
samples.hypothesis: Synthetic speeds and subtitles stay together for long periods of time to satisfy reading constraints.

samples.source: 语音素材的时长统计要按有效语音段而非文件长度。
samples.reference: Measure voice material by active speech span, not file length.
samples.hypothesis: The length of the speech material is measured by a valid voice segment rather than by the length of the file.

samples.source: 链路里的每段延迟都要单独可测，否则优化无据。
samples.reference: Make each stage's latency measurable, or optimisation has no basis.
samples.hypothesis: Each part of the chain is separately detectable, otherwise it will be optimized without evidence.

samples.source: 模型体积与首次可用时间的权衡由产品场景决定。
samples.reference: Balance model size against time-to-first-use by product scenario.
samples.hypothesis: The trade-off between the size of the model and the time available for the first time is determined by the product landscape.

samples.source: 语音交付的验收要在目标机型上做，而不是开发机。
samples.reference: Accept voice delivery on the target machine, not the development box.
samples.hypothesis: The voice delivery is to be performed on the target model rather than on the developer.

samples.source: 语音闭环的失败要指出是哪一段失败，不整体报错.
samples.reference: Failures in the voice loop must name the failing stage, not the loop as a whole.
samples.hypothesis: The failure of the closed voice is an indication of which part of the failure is not reported as a whole.

samples.source: 识别词表要能按客户领域追加，避免硬改模型。
samples.reference: Extend recognition vocabularies per customer domain instead of patching a model.
samples.hypothesis: The list of identifying words should be able to be added by client area to avoid hard-on-model changes.

samples.source: 合成产物要能保留参数记录，便于复现同一效果。
samples.reference: Keep synthesis parameters so the same result can be reproduced.
samples.hypothesis: Synthetics need to be able to maintain a record of parameters to allow the same effect to be repeated.

samples.source: 语音链路的质量与延迟要在同一报表里对照呈现。
samples.reference: Show voice quality and latency side by side in one report.
samples.hypothesis: The quality and delay of the voice link are shown in the same statement.

samples.source: 模型清单要注明每个模型的许可、体积与获取方式。
samples.reference: List each model's licence, size and fetch method in the manifest.
samples.hypothesis: The list of models shall indicate the licence, volume and acquisition of each model.

samples.source: 语音评测的语料许可要与产物许可一致，避免污染。
samples.reference: Keep voice evaluation corpora licence-compatible with the product.
samples.hypothesis: The language of the speech assessment is authorized to be consistent with the product licence and to avoid contamination.

samples.source: 链路的可观测性要覆盖到每段起止时间。
samples.reference: Instrument start and end times for every stage of the chain.
samples.hypothesis: Visibility of the links should be covered by each period of time.

samples.source: 识别与合成的语言支持面要分别声明，不共用一个列表。
samples.reference: Declare recognition and synthesis language support separately, not as one list.
samples.hypothesis: Identification and synthesis of language support are to be declared separately and not shared in a list.

samples.source: 模型获取失败要给出可复制命令与校验和预期。
samples.reference: On a model fetch failure, print the copyable command and the expected digest.
samples.hypothesis: The model acquisition failed to give a copyable command and check and expect.

samples.source: 一次请求要能回读它走过的路径、耗时与最终引擎。
samples.reference: A request should read back the path it took, the time each stage spent and the engine that answered.
samples.hypothesis: One request is to be able to read back the path, time-consuming and final engine it has passed.

samples.source: 健康检查要区分存活、就绪与忙碌三种状态。
samples.reference: A health check should separate alive, ready and busy rather than collapsing them.
samples.hypothesis: Health check-ups distinguish between survival, readiness and busy states.

samples.source: 排队中的请求要计入可见指标，否则运维只能从时间推断。
samples.reference: Requests waiting in a queue need a visible metric, or operators can only infer them from timing.
samples.hypothesis: Queued requests are to be counted against visible indicators, otherwise the dimensions can only be extrapolated from time.

samples.source: 超时配置要有上界，超出表示范围会直接断开而不是等更久。
samples.reference: A wait limit needs an upper bound; past the representable range it severs instead of waiting.
samples.hypothesis: The time-out configuration needs to be upper bounds and beyond the range of indications will be directly disconnected rather than waiting longer.

samples.source: 被放弃的请求要记账，因为它仍然消耗了一次真实计算。
samples.reference: Record abandoned requests, since they still consumed a real computation.
samples.hypothesis: The abandoned request is recorded because it still consumes a true calculation.

samples.source: 一个建议等待时长要来自已完成工作的分位数，而不是平均值。
samples.reference: A suggested wait should come from a quantile of finished work, not from an average.
samples.hypothesis: The length of the waiting period for a proposal is derived from the fraction of the work done, rather than from the average.

samples.source: 重启兜底要能被主动触发，而不是等它自己发生。
samples.reference: A bounded restart must be triggerable on purpose, not only by accident.
samples.hypothesis: Restarting the wall needs to be activated on its own, not waiting for it to happen.

samples.source: 评测跑批要按语言对限定范围，避免覆盖其他引擎的证据。
samples.reference: Scope an evaluation run by pair and engine, so evidence belonging elsewhere survives.
samples.hypothesis: The evaluation run is limited by language to avoid covering the evidence of other engines.

samples.source: 一个批次结束时给出汇总：条数、失败数、耗时分布与退出码。
samples.reference: Close a batch with a summary: counts, failures, the latency distribution and an exit code.
samples.hypothesis: A summary is given at the end of a batch: number of bars, number of failures, time-consuming distribution and exit code.

samples.source: 观测数据要能区分自身开销与被测对象的开销。
samples.reference: Observability data must separate its own cost from the measured system's cost.
samples.hypothesis: Observation data should distinguish between self-expense and the cost of the object being measured.

samples.source: 一次故障复现要留下最小可重放输入。
samples.reference: Leave a minimal replayable input for every reproduced failure.
samples.hypothesis: A single occurrence leaves a minimum replayable input.

samples.source: 指标命名要带单位与口径，避免同名指标两种含义。
samples.reference: Name metrics with unit and definition, or one label carries two meanings.
samples.hypothesis: The name of the indicator should be given in unit and calibre, avoiding the meaning of the same name as the indicator.

samples.source: 长时运行的告警要基于趋势与噪声带，不基于单点。
samples.reference: Long-run alerts should key off trend and noise band, not a single point.
samples.hypothesis: Long-term alerts are based on trends and noise tapes and not on single points.

samples.source: 一次变更的影响要用同机同负载前后对比。
samples.reference: Judge a change on the same machine and load, comparing before and after.
samples.hypothesis: The impact of a single change is to be compared with the load.

samples.source: 评测结果要能重跑出同样的身份名，便于版本追溯。
samples.reference: A rerun must land under the same identity name, for traceability across versions.
samples.hypothesis: The results of the evaluation should be capable of re-examining the same identity and facilitate the retroactive use of the version.

samples.source: 日志要能按请求标识聚合，而不是只能按时间顺序读。
samples.reference: Aggregate logs by request identity, not only by time order.
samples.hypothesis: Logs should be able to mark aggregations as requested, rather than being read only in chronological order.

samples.source: 一个指标的绝对值不可比，跨环境只引用相对差。
samples.reference: Absolute metric values are not comparable across environments; cite the relative difference.
samples.hypothesis: The absolute value of an indicator is incomparable, and only the relative difference is cited across the environment.

samples.source: 观测接口的字段要向后兼容并标注未知含义。
samples.reference: Keep observability fields backward compatible and say what an unknown means.
samples.hypothesis: Fields of the observation interface are to be re-compatible and given unknown meanings.

samples.source: 失败行要单独落盘，便于重跑而不重复成功部分。
samples.reference: Persist failed rows separately, so a rerun does not repeat what already succeeded.
samples.hypothesis: Failure lines need to be left on their own so that they can run again without repeating the successes.

samples.source: 一个流程的可观测性以能否定位到阶段为准。
samples.reference: A process is observable when a fault can be localised to a stage.
samples.hypothesis: The observability of a process depends on its positioning to the stage.

samples.source: 评测要报告分母，未答出的行不能被算成质量差。
samples.reference: Report the denominator; unanswered rows must not be scored as low quality.
samples.hypothesis: The assessment is to report the denominator, and the outstanding lines cannot be counted as poor quality.

samples.source: 一次跑批的环境要记录芯片、内存、并发与常驻服务。
samples.reference: Log chip, memory, concurrency and resident services for every run.
samples.hypothesis: A run-off environment requires the recording of chips, memory, and co-location services.

samples.source: 一个指标的抖动要给出噪声带而不是只给两点。
samples.reference: Present jitter as a noise band, not as two numbers to compare.
samples.hypothesis: One indicator is to give a noise tape rather than just two points.

samples.source: 运维手册要写清哪些指标能判断需要扩容。
samples.reference: State which metrics indicate a need to scale, in the operations runbook.
samples.hypothesis: The manual is intended to clarify which indicators will make it possible to judge the need for expansion.

samples.source: 一次修复后要先确认旧遮盖手段已移除。
samples.reference: After a fix, confirm the workaround that hid it is gone.
samples.hypothesis: After one restoration, confirm that the old cover was removed.

samples.source: 评测样本的顺序会造出假退化，回访同一批才能分辨。
samples.reference: Sample order can fake degradation; revisit the same rows to tell them apart.
samples.hypothesis: The order in which the samples are evaluated is falsely degraded and can only be identified by returning to the same group.

samples.source: 一个未度量的环节不要声称已经优化。
samples.reference: Do not claim an unmeasured step has been optimised.
samples.hypothesis: An unmeasured link does not claim to have been optimized.

samples.source: 指标的采集频率要高于退化发生的时间尺度。
samples.reference: Sample metrics finer than the timescale on which decay appears.
samples.hypothesis: Indicators are collected more frequently than the timescale at which degradation occurs.

samples.source: 一次交付的验收要包含一条端到端可复现命令。
samples.reference: Acceptance of a delivery includes one end-to-end reproducible command.
samples.hypothesis: The acceptance of a single delivery must contain an end-to-end replicability command.

samples.source: 评测报表要指出未覆盖的语言对与领域组合。
samples.reference: An evaluation report names the pairs and domains it does not cover.
samples.hypothesis: The assessment report indicates the combination of uncovered language pairs with the field.

samples.source: 一个结论若依赖特定服务在跑，要在正文里写明。
samples.reference: State in the body when a conclusion depends on some service running.
samples.hypothesis: A conclusion that depends on a particular service is to be found in the body of the document.

samples.source: 观测要覆盖等待时间，不只是处理时间。
samples.reference: Observe waiting time as well as processing time.
samples.hypothesis: Observation covers waiting time, not just processing time.

samples.source: 一次异常的现场要包含版本、配置与输入摘要。
samples.reference: An incident record holds version, config and an input digest.
samples.hypothesis: An unusual site contains a summary of the version, configuration and input.

samples.source: 指标口径变更要同时改代码与文档，不能只改一处。
samples.reference: Update code and docs together when a metric definition changes.
samples.hypothesis: The change in the calibration of indicators should be accompanied by a change in the code and document and not by a single change.

samples.source: 一个跑批的日志要能安全公开，不含客户正文。
samples.reference: Keep batch logs safe to publish, without client text.
samples.hypothesis: A running journal should be safe and public, without the client's body.

samples.source: 评测的对照组要固定为同一构建与同一数据目录。
samples.reference: Fix the control group to one build and one data directory.
samples.hypothesis: The control group to evaluate is to be fixed to the same building and directory of the same data.

samples.source: 一次评测要能在报告里指回它的证据文件。
samples.reference: Every reported number should point back to its evidence artefact.
samples.hypothesis: A single assessment should be able to point back its evidentiary documents in the report.

samples.source: 运维指标要能区分用户可感等待与内部等待。
samples.reference: Distinguish user-visible waiting from internal waiting in operations metrics.
samples.hypothesis: The operational indicators need to be able to distinguish between user-sensible and internal waiting.

samples.source: 一个阈值要有来源，不能沿用上一次的经验数字。
samples.reference: Give every threshold a source instead of inheriting the previous number.
samples.hypothesis: A threshold must be sourced, and previous experience figures cannot be used.

samples.source: 评测结束要清理常驻服务，避免污染下一次测量。
samples.reference: Clean up resident services after a run, so the next measurement is not polluted.
samples.hypothesis: The evaluation is completed by cleaning up the residential service and avoiding contamination of the next measurement.

samples.source: 一次故障的结论要写它排除了什么。
samples.reference: State what an incident conclusion ruled out, not only what it found.
samples.hypothesis: The conclusion of a failure is to say what it excludes.

samples.source: 报表里的每个百分比都要能追到计数。
samples.reference: Trace every percentage in a report back to its counts.
samples.hypothesis: Each percentage in the statement must be able to count.

samples.source: 一个未复采的差值要标注为单次观测。
samples.reference: Mark an unreplicated difference as a single observation.
samples.hypothesis: An unrepeated margin should be labelled as a single observation.

samples.source: 评测脚本要能在他人机器上原样运行。
samples.reference: Evaluation scripts must run unchanged on someone else's machine.
samples.hypothesis: The script should be evaluated so that it can be run in the same way on another machine.

samples.source: 一次交付后的回访要复用同一身份名以便比较。
samples.reference: A follow-up visit reuses the same identity name so the two runs compare.
samples.hypothesis: A return visit after a delivery is made by using the same identity for comparison purposes.

samples.source: 观测数据缺失时要显式报缺，不补默认值。
samples.reference: Report a missing observation instead of defaulting it.
samples.hypothesis: When observations are missing, the default value is not filled.

samples.source: 一个指标的用途要在采集时就确定。
samples.reference: Decide a metric's purpose when it is collected, not afterwards.
samples.hypothesis: The use of an indicator is to be determined at the time of collection.

samples.source: 评测报告要写清样本量不足时不判定的规则。
samples.reference: State the rule that refuses a conclusion when the sample is too small.
samples.hypothesis: The evaluation report should contain rules for non-conviction when the sample is insufficient.

samples.source: 一次评测的可信度来自它能被推翻。
samples.reference: An evaluation is trustworthy because it could have failed.
samples.hypothesis: The credibility of one assessment comes from its ability to be overturned.
